production.note: US model years 2012 to 2013. Motor Authority (Nelson Ireson, 4 October 2011) reports Volkswagen's "official U.S. pricing and specs" for the 2012 Golf R; Volkswagen's "2013 Golf R Technical Specifications" covers 2013 (vw-us-2013-golf-r-techspecs). Cars.com lists this generation as "2012-2013" and the next as 2015-2019 (carscom-golf-r-years).

body.note: Two-door and four-door hatchbacks (spec sheet rows "2D/4D"; Motor Authority: two-door and four-door).

configuration.note: Spec sheet: "2.0L inline four cylinder, 16V, turbocharged/intercooled, TSI"

displacementL.note: 1,984 cc. Spec sheet: "121 cu in 1984 cc"

fuel.note: Gasoline TSI engine; inferred from the spec sheet.

drivetrain.note: Spec sheet: "4Motion permanent all-wheel-drive system with Haldex® center differential"

transmission.note: Spec sheet lists a six-speed manual only. Motor Authority: "Only a six-speed manual transmission is offered" (the European car's DSG was not sold in the US).

powerHp.note: Quote (spec sheet): "Horsepower (SAE) @ rpm 256 @ 6000 (188 kW @ 6000)". Same rating for 2012: Motor Authority "256 hp, arriving at 6,000 rpm" (motorauthority-2012-golf-r-specs).

weightLb.note: Spec sheet row "Curb Weight 2D/4D 3325 lb 1508 kg" (manual, the only transmission; one figure printed under the 2D/4D heading). Motor Authority gives the same 3,325 pounds for the 2012 car. Reference year is 2013 because the 2012 figure has only one publication behind it.

sources.title: Report on the official 2012 Volkswagen Golf R US price and specs (Nelson Ireson, 4 October 2011)
